problem: Suppose that $A$ and $B$ are mutually exclusive events. Given that $P(B)=\frac{18}{25}$ and $P(A\cup B)=\frac{4}{5},$ find $P(A).$

feedback.problem: Suppose that $A$ and $B$ are mutually exclusive events. Given that $P(A)=\frac{2}{7}$ and $P(A\cup B)=\frac{3}{4},$ find $P(B).$
feedback.worked_solution:
If $A$ and $B$ are mutually exclusive events, then $P(A\cap B)=0.$

Therefore, by the addition law, we have that

$$
\begin{aligned}P(A\cup B) & =P(A)+P(B) \\ P(B) & =P(A\cup B)-P(A) \\  & =\frac{3}{4}-\frac{2}{7} \\  & =\frac{21-8}{28} \\  & =\frac{13}{28}\,.\end{aligned}
$$
